question: Coimbatore, which is located in the state of ______, is famous for the cotton textile industry.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Coimbatore**, located in Tamil Nadu, is known as the **"Manchester of South India"** due to its prominent cotton textile industry.
 
• The city has a favorable climate for cotton production and is supported by the nearby **Noyyal River**, which provides water for textile operations.
 
• Coimbatore is home to numerous **textile mills, engineering firms, and educational institutions**, contributing significantly to its industrial development.
 
• The city is also a hub for **yarn and knitwear exports** and hosts several textile exhibitions, attracting global buyers.
 
• The availability of skilled labor, raw materials, and advanced technology has cemented Coimbatore's reputation as a leader in the Indian textile industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cotton Textile Industry in India:**

 
 
• India is the second-largest producer of cotton in the world, contributing significantly to its textile exports.
 
• The textile industry in India is labor-intensive and one of the largest employers, providing jobs to millions of people.
 
• Major cotton-producing states include Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Textile Clusters in Tamil Nadu:**
 
 
• Apart from Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu has textile hubs in places like Tiruppur, Karur, and Salem.
 
• Tiruppur is renowned for its knitwear exports, while Karur specializes in home textiles.
 
 
 
• **Industrial Development in Coimbatore:**
 
 
• The city is also known for its engineering industries, particularly in the production of pumps, motors, and auto components.
 
• It serves as a major center for education and research in textile technology and engineering.
 
 
 
• **Historical Significance:**
 
 
• The textile industry in Coimbatore dates back to the early 20th century, with the establishment of numerous spinning mills.
 
• The British colonial government played a role in developing the region's infrastructure, which helped the textile industry flourish.
